title: HADES vs PLAIN STACK ordinary greeting — local matched agent path
status: three warm synthetic pairs; directional; no owner preference

method.surface: Hermes 0.21.5 AIAgent.run_conversation called directly in one fresh Python process per turn; HADES case imports the committed HADES sitecustomize overlay and supplies a synthetic owner gateway_session_key
method.fairness: same Hermes source/venv, model, runtime, hardware, prompt, context, sampling defaults, max-token configuration, and reasoning_config enabled=false; run order alternated
method.warm_state: Ollama model loaded; each stack's prompt prefix had been warmed before the three recorded pairs; cache-read and prompt token counts are retained
method.data: synthetic greeting only; no owner transcript, live service, MCP call, or persistent owner state
method.ttft: AIAgent constructor start to first nonempty stream callback; includes per-agent initialization, HADES routing, prompt prefill, and model response; Python imports occur before the timer
method.tool_check: each result had one model API call and only user/assistant message roles; no tool call

conditions.hermes: 0.21.5, source commit f97608f178d1ffeca59860195ab7da295f7c8e5f, same candidate venv for both
conditions.ollama: 0.35.1 staged official archive SHA-256 9fcd79ac4575b2bd31b992eee18b1000c8ad126b451627c8f8cd091714cfbb10, bound to 127.0.0.1:11445
conditions.hardware: same host and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU; Ollama reported 12.9 GB model VRAM use of 16 GB during this run
conditions.comparison_gap: staged model digest differs from the existing production endpoint model digest 096fdbd02fe620fc10cbeb6537e080f8041aece851e5d696aed024d4f70f2e47e; the staged result is not production-equivalent

summary.interpretation: HADES materially reduces context and schemas but does not improve TTFT in this sample. HADES completion wall is 47.9 ms lower at the median while generating much shorter replies; this is not a meaningful latency win. PLAIN answers are more elaborated, HADES answers are shorter. Scotty preference is unknown.

limits: Three pairs on one ordinary greeting are directional only.
Direct AIAgent construction does not include Open WebUI, the running Hermes API gateway, network proxy, HADES MCP services, Hindsight recall, or owner data.
PLAIN Stack and HADES prompts intentionally differ in overlay context and tool exposure; the benchmark measures that stack tax rather than holding system prompt bytes fixed.
TTFT includes Python/Hermes startup and HADES routing; stage-level attribution is not available.
The local candidate model digest differs from the model digest observed on the existing production inference host, and hardware is different.
